about: v2.1 (Argon F6): 8 offline micro-tasks, 2 per domain of the owner's real work (career, website, brand, 3d). gym.py --suite work-tasks copies setup/ into a temp folder, runs the agent (BRAIN_WORK_AGENT=<command>, given the prompt as its last argument) or, by default, the reference solution.py, then scores with Tier 0 checks. Default mode proves the suite and the checks are sound; agent mode measures a harness.

tasks.prompt: Export cv.md as a ONE-page PDF named cv.pdf.
cv.md must have the sections Experience, Education and Skills (add the missing ones, empty is fine).
Make card.html: a one-page contact card with a heading, that works on a 375px phone (viewport meta, no fixed width over 375px).
index.html links to about.html, which is missing. Fix it so every local link resolves.
style.css must use only the colours in palette.json.
Make logo.svg (a simple mark) that uses only palette.json colours.
Write bracket.stl: a watertight block 40 x 20 x 5 mm.
plate.stl was exported in centimetres (4 x 2 x 0.5). Re-export it in millimetres as plate.stl, still watertight.
